facts.text: I wake up rested and prepared for a new day of adventures.
I ask the innkeeper about any rumours in town.
I ask whether I can afford to buy a horse with the gold jarl has awarded me.
I suggest that we do not need a horse yet.
I suggest that the woods are not that far away.
I suggest that some gold could prove useful later on.
I ask what awaits us on our journey to the woods.
I slowly proceed into the cave.
I sneak up to the cultists and take a surprise strike at them with a random spell.
I examine the cultists bodies for any valualbe loot.

keyphrases: surprise strike with a random spell

events.text: Talk to the innkeeper, buy supplies, and ask about rumours in town
Ask whether I can afford to buy a horse with the gold jarl awarded me
Venture out by foot toward the woods instead of buying a horse
Sneak up to the cultists and attack with a random spell
Examine the cultists bodies for valuable loot
